meta.title: MedHub, the health information system that never stops
meta.description: Patient records, consultation, cashier, pharmacy and laboratory for health facilities, even without a connection.

hero.badge: Built for the DRC, in French and English
hero.subtitle: Front desk, consultation, cashier, pharmacy and laboratory on a single platform. Every workstation keeps working without a network and syncs as soon as the connection returns.

pillars.title: A tool designed for the field
pillars.subtitle: Unstable power, intermittent network, mixed hardware: MedHub is built for these conditions from day one.

offline.title: Always available
offline.text: Registration, consultation, cashier and dispensing work without a connection. Nothing is lost, nothing is typed twice.

record.title: Longitudinal record
record.text: Allergies, history, medications and vital signs on a single screen at every consultation.

finance.title: Secured revenue
finance.text: Immutable invoices and cash movements, amounts in USD and CDF, discrepancies detected the same day.

config.title: Configurable without code
config.text: Roles, prices, contracts, forms and printed documents are set in the interface.

facts.currencies: currencies handled natively: USD and CDF
facts.isolation: facilities isolated by the database itself

modules.title: One platform for the whole facility
modules.subtitle: Enable the modules you need, from the neighbourhood pharmacy to the multi-site hospital.

patients.title: Front desk and patient record
patients.text: Typo-tolerant search, quick registration in under a minute, duplicate detection and a patient card with QR code.

clinical.title: Consultation and prescribing
clinical.text: Triage, vital signs with plausibility checks, signed notes, coded diagnoses and prescribing with alerts.

billing.title: Billing and cashier
billing.text: Basket fed by the acts performed, patient and third-party shares, multi-currency payments and cash closing.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy and stock
pharmacy.text: Dispensing linked to prescriptions, stock computed from movements, lots and expiry dates tracked.

lab.title: Laboratory
lab.text: Orders, specimen collection, result entry and validation, critical values flagged immediately.

integrated.title: Integrated patient record
integrated.text: Information entered once feeds the invoice, the stock and the reports.

workflows.title: Configurable workflows
workflows.text: Each facility sets its roles, prices and forms without development.

billing.title: Stock and billing linked
billing.text: Dispensing takes the stock out and adds the invoice line automatically.

security.title: Security and traceability
security.text: Hash-chained audit log, traced emergency access, encrypted data on every workstation.

hosting.title: Realistic hosting
hosting.text: Runs on standard cPanel hosting and moves to a dedicated server without a rewrite.

pricing.title: Simple, predictable pricing
pricing.subtitle: No upfront investment, a monthly subscription sized to your facility.
pricing.disclaimer: Indicative values in US dollars, confirmed at subscription. Congolese franc equivalent at the daily rate.

cta.title: Ready to get your facility running?
cta.subtitle: A health post can be operational in less than five working days.

footer.tagline: Local-first health information system for health facilities.

auth.title: Sign in to your facility
auth.subtitle: Enter your facility code, then your credentials.
auth.tenantCodeHint: Example: HOP-KIN-0042. It is remembered on this workstation.
auth.offline: No connection: the first sign-in on a workstation must be online. If this workstation is already activated, unlock it with your PIN.
auth.secureNote: Encrypted connection. No password is stored on this workstation.
auth.sideTitle: Your facility, even without a network
auth.sideText: Once this workstation is activated, front desk, consultation and cashier keep working during outages.

pinSetup.title: Activate this workstation
pinSetup.subtitle: Choose a PIN of at least 6 digits. It unlocks your data on this workstation, even offline.
pinSetup.tooShort: The PIN must have at least 6 digits.
pinSetup.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.

recovery.title: Recovery code
recovery.text: Write this code down and keep it safe. It recovers unsent operations if the PIN is forgotten. It will not be shown again.
recovery.confirm: I have stored this code safely

unlock.title: Workstation locked
unlock.subtitle: Enter your PIN to continue.
unlock.wrong: Wrong PIN. {remaining, plural, one {# attempt left} other {# attempts left}}.
unlock.blocked: Too many attempts. Use your recovery code or sign in online.
unlock.wiped: Too many attempts: local data on this workstation was erased. Sign in online.
unlock.noLocal: This workstation is not activated for this user yet. Sign in online.
unlock.offlineExpired: Offline access on this device has expired. Sign in online to renew it: your pending operations are kept.

errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Account temporarily locked after several failures. Try again later.
errors.AUTH_TENANT_SUSPENDED: This facility is suspended. Contact your administrator.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.NETWORK: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection.
errors.AUTH_MFA_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: Time is up. Start signing in again.
errors.AUTH_MFA_REQUIRED_BY_ROLE: Your role requires two-factor authentication: it cannot be turned off.
errors.AUTH_MFA_NOT_ENROLLED: Two-factor authentication is not set up.
errors.IP_BLOCKED: Access refused from this network address.
errors.AUTH_NO_ACTIVE_ROLE: Your account has no active role. Ask the facility administrator to assign one.
errors.AUTH_PASSWORD_REUSED: Choose a password different from the current one.
errors.AUTH_USER_DISABLED: This account was disabled by the facility administrator.

mfa.verifyText: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryText: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
mfa.enrollText: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, FreeOTP, Aegis...) on your phone.
mfa.enrollStep1: Open the authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.enrollStep2: Scan the QR code or type the key manually.
mfa.enrollStep3: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
mfa.recoveryCodesText: If you lose your phone, each of these codes allows a single sign-in. Print them or write them down somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
mfa.recoveryConfirm: I have stored these codes somewhere safe

auth.deviceRetired: This device was retired or declared lost by your structure administrator: its local data has been erased. Sign in to activate it again if needed.

passwordProblems.too_long: It is too long (128 characters at most).
passwordProblems.common: It is too common and easy to guess.
passwordProblems.contains_identity: It must not contain your name or username.

passwordChange.title: Choose your password
passwordChange.subtitle: You signed in with a temporary password. Replace it with one only you know.
passwordChange.hint: At least {min} characters. A phrase of several words is safer and easier to remember than a complicated word.
passwordChange.mismatch: The two entries do not match.

banners.grace: The structure subscription is overdue: contact the administrator.
banners.readOnly: The structure subscription is read-only. Emergency access and export remain available.
banners.suspended: The structure subscription is suspended. Emergency access and export remain available.
banners.offlineExpiring: Offline access on this device expires on {date}: sync it before then.

duplicates.confirmHint: If this is someone else, register anyway: a possible duplicate will be reported by the server in any case.

queue.subtitle: Records the server finds similar after synchronisation.
queue.intro: Compare both records. If they are two different people, dismiss the pair with a reason; merging comes in the next version.
queue.offline: Screen available online only: duplicates are computed by the server.
queue.denied: You are not allowed to handle duplicates.
queue.network: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection.
queue.error: The operation failed: the pair may already have been handled.
queue.mergeSoon: Merging comes in the next version.

diagnostic.catalogsReloaded: Reference data reloaded from the server.
diagnostic.journalExported: Journal saved: {file}. Send this file to MedHub support.
diagnostic.journalUnavailable: Export not possible: this device has not received the support key yet. Sync it once online, or contact the platform administrator.
diagnostic.journalHint: The journal holds no name and no medical data: only counters, technical identifiers and error codes. It is encrypted for MedHub support, who alone can read it.

errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to perform this action.
errors.DPI_VITAL_IMPLAUSIBLE: Value outside plausible limits: a reason is required.

account.subtitle: Sign-in security, open sessions and appearance.
account.offline: This screen is only available online. Reconnect this device to manage account security.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.text: A 6-digit code from your phone is required at every sign-in, in addition to the password.
mfa.codesLeft: {count, plural, =0 {no recovery code left} one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}
mfa.requiredByRole: Your role requires two-factor authentication: you will be asked to set it up at your next sign-in.
mfa.confirmRegenerate: The old recovery codes will stop working. Confirm with an app code or a recovery code.
mfa.confirmDisable: Confirm with an app code or a recovery code.

sessions.text: Devices signed in to your account. Sign out the ones you do not recognise.

stepUp.title: Confirm your identity
stepUp.text: This change is sensitive. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.
stepUp.notEnrolled: This change requires two-factor authentication. Turn it on in "My account", then try again.

settings.subtitle: Configuration of the structure. Available online only.

training.text: Copy of the facility with fictitious patients, to learn without risk

structure.title: Structure
structure.text: Information used on printed documents and reports.
structure.legalMentionsHint: Approval number, tax identifier, address... as your structure must print them.

sites.title: Sites
sites.text: Places where the structure works. One site always stays active.
sites.codeHint: The code appears in document numbers: it cannot be changed later.
sites.name: Site name

departments.title: Departments
departments.text: Departments of each site: used by queues, department-scoped rights and reports.
departments.name: Department name

security.offline: This screen is only available online.

errors.ORG_SITE_INACTIVE: This site is inactive: reactivate it before adding a department.

errors.USER_IS_SELF: This action cannot target your own account. Use "My account".
errors.USER_ROLE_UNKNOWN: One of the selected roles does not exist anymore.
errors.AUTH_MFA_NOT_ENROLLED: This user has no two-factor authentication to reset.

devices.title: Devices
devices.subtitle: Devices activated in the structure. A retired or lost device erases its data at its next contact.
devices.diskHint: Recommendation: turn on disk encryption on the devices (BitLocker, FileVault, Android encryption).
devices.revokeWarning: The device will no longer sync. At its next contact with the server, it will erase its local data.
devices.lostWarning: All sessions of the device end immediately. At its next contact, it will erase its local data, including unsent operations.
devices.allowFinalPush: Let the device send its pending operations one last time before erasing itself

errors.DEVICE_IS_CURRENT: You cannot retire the device you are using.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED: Identity confirmation cancelled: nothing was changed.

configuration.title: Devices and security
configuration.subtitle: Settings applied to every device of the structure, published by version.
configuration.lifecycle: Every change goes through a draft, then a publication. A published version is never changed: the previous one is archived and can be restored. Devices receive the published values at their next sync.

offline_token_days.title: Offline access
offline_token_days.text: How long a device may work without syncing (1 to 30 days). After that, an online sign-in is required; nothing is lost.

auto_lock_minutes.title: Auto-lock
auto_lock_minutes.text: Inactivity delay before the device asks for the PIN (1 to 60 minutes).

pin_max_attempts.title: PIN attempts
pin_max_attempts.text: Attempts before blocking (3 to 20). Data is only erased when no operation is waiting to be sent.

step_up_minutes.title: Confirmation of sensitive changes
step_up_minutes.text: How long the last proof of the second factor stays valid before a configuration change (5 to 60 minutes).

password_min_length.title: Minimum password length
password_min_length.text: Minimum number of characters (10 to 64). No composition rule is imposed: a phrase of several words is recommended.

duplicate_alert_score.title: Duplicate alert at registration
duplicate_alert_score.text: Similarity score from which the device shows similar patients before creating a new one (30 to 100).

duplicate_candidate_score.title: Merge candidate
duplicate_candidate_score.text: Score from which the server lists two records in the duplicates queue (30 to 120).

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Facility accounts, roles, assignments and resets.
users.listText: An account is never deleted: it is disabled and stays visible in the audit log.
users.newText: A temporary password is created and shown once. The user replaces it at first sign-in.
users.showDisabled: {count, plural, one {Show the disabled account} other {Show the # disabled accounts}}
users.usernameHint: Lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash; starts with a letter. Cannot change later.
users.usernameFixed: The username never changes: it appears in the audit log and on signed documents.
users.rolesHint: At least one role. A role marked "2FA" requires two-factor authentication.

temporary.title: Temporary password for {name}
temporary.text: Hand it over in person. It will not be shown again; the user must replace it at first sign-in.

actions.title: Account actions
actions.self: For your own account, use "My account".
actions.resetMfaHint: Use it when the phone was lost or replaced. Their sessions end; if their role requires it, they set up a new phone at next sign-in.
actions.disableHint: Their sessions end at once; each of their devices loses offline access at its next sync. Nothing is deleted.
actions.enableHint: The user will be able to sign in again with their password.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: What each role allows, and over which scope. Template roles are editable copies.
roles.listText: A user may hold several roles: their permissions add up.
roles.newText: Start from an empty role or duplicate an existing one, then adjust its permissions.
roles.counts: {members, plural, =0 {no user} one {# user} other {# users}} · {permissions, plural, =0 {no permission} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
roles.version: Version {version} · {members, plural, =0 {no active user} one {# active user} other {# active users}}
roles.codeHint: Lower-case letters, digits and _; cannot change later.
roles.requiresMfaHint: Holders of this role will set up 2FA at their next sign-in.
roles.privilegedHint: This role grants administration rights (shield icon): two-factor authentication is always required.

template.same: Same as the MedHub template role.
template.differs: {count, plural, one {# difference} other {# differences}} with the MedHub template role.

roles.permissionsHint: Tick the allowed actions. The scope applies to every ticked action of the row. Changes apply from the next request, and on each device at its next sync.
roles.pending: {added, plural, =0 {} one {# added} other {# added}} {removed, plural, =0 {} one {# removed} other {# removed}} {rescoped, plural, =0 {} one {# scope changed} other {# scopes changed}}

reference.title: Reference data
reference.subtitle: Pick lists of the facility and catalogs shared by the platform. They are copied to every device for offline work.
reference.listsText: Values offered in forms (arrival mode, occupation...). An item is never deleted: it is deactivated.
reference.itemCount: {count, plural, =0 {no active item} one {# active item} other {# active items}}
reference.noItems: No item: add some or import a file.
reference.itemsHint: The code of a saved item never changes (recorded data refers to it). To remove an item, untick "Active".

import.title: Import from a CSV file
import.hint: Columns: code, libelle, libelle_en (optional), ordre (optional). Separator ";" or ",". The file is first checked line by line; nothing is saved before "Save list".
import.paste: Or paste the file content here
import.summary: {valid, plural, =0 {No valid line} one {# valid line} other {# valid lines}}, {errors, plural, =0 {no error} one {# error} other {# errors}}.
import.apply: {count, plural, one {Take the line into the list} other {Take the # lines into the list}}

problems.too_many_rows: file too long (2,000 lines at most)

platform.title: Platform catalogs
platform.text: Shared by every facility, maintained by MedHub, read-only.
platform.areasHint: The 26 provinces are provided (2006 Constitution, ISO 3166-2:CD codes). Territories, cities and communes will be loaded from an official file.
platform.unitsHint: UCUM codes, used by vital signs and results.

training.title: Training base
training.subtitle: A practice facility next to yours: same configuration, same accounts, fictitious patients.
training.cardText: Staff practise there without touching real records.
training.codeLabel: Facility code to enter at sign-in
training.codeHint: Same usernames and passwords as in the real facility.
training.counts: {users, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}, {patients, plural, one {# fictitious patient} other {# fictitious patients}}
training.resetConfirm: The current base is archived (nothing is deleted) and its devices erase their training data at their next contact. A new base is created under the same code, with today's configuration and new fictitious patients.
training.archived: {count, plural, one {# previous base archived} other {# previous bases archived}}, kept but no longer accessible.
training.insideTraining: You are signed in to a training base: it cannot have a training base of its own.

how.copy: Copy of the published configuration, sites and departments, roles, pick lists and active accounts (same passwords and two-factor authentication).
how.signIn: To practise, everyone signs in with the training base code instead of the usual one.
how.banner: A "Training base" banner stays on screen at all times to avoid any confusion.
how.messages: No real SMS or email leaves it: sending is simulated.
how.reset: Resetting starts again from today's configuration; the previous base is archived, never deleted.
